title: Representative independence of the source-only stalk map
statement: For any cartesian square of schemes [def-pc-base-change], any derived K on X, K-flat sheaf complexes P,Q with eP:QP≅K and eQ:QQ≅K and invertible pullback counits, fix p in X' and i. Write rP,rQ for the two source-only maps [def-pc-affine-base-change-into-pullback]. There exists an additive equivalence t:source(rQ)≃source(rP) such that rQ(x)=rP(t(x)) for every x. No affine scheme or termwise quasi-coherence hypothesis is used, and no global module U,a,d is asserted.

proof.text: Apply exact stalks to eQ followed by eP inverse and the unique counit-compatible derived scalar-extension comparison to obtain an isomorphism of base-derived cohomology. The cohomologyIso_smul equations respect the tensor-algebra action, so extension to the fourth ring gives t.

Use comparison_eq, localized_eq and counit naturality to commute the comparison square. The tensor-stalk identification and exact representative comparison identify its common target with stalk cohomology of Lg'^*K, giving rQ=rP∘t.

lean.statement: theorem exists_affineBaseChangeIntoPullback_representativeIso {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X) (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (P Q : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) (hP : P.IsKFlat) (hQ : Q.IsKFlat) (eP : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅ K) (eQ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q ≅ K) (hcP : IsIso ((SingleComplexBaseChange.counit g').app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P))) (hcQ : IsIso ((SingleComplexBaseChange.counit g').app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj Q))) (p : X') (i : ℤ) : ∃ t : (Arrow.mk (affineBaseChangeIntoPullback f f' g g' sq K Q eQ hcQ p i)).left ≃+ (Arrow.mk (affineBaseChangeIntoPullback f f' g g' sq K P eP hcP p i)).left, ∀ x, affineBaseChangeIntoPullback f f' g g' sq K Q eQ hcQ p i x = affineBaseChangeIntoPullback f f' g g' sq K P eP hcP p i (t x)
